tasks.title: Audit RoBAS and establish rolling CAD contracts
tasks.objective: Audit private RoBAS C# CAD geometry and document formulas, unit normalization and build an Assembly/Part contract independent of the existing three-part journal bearing pipeline. Add test fixtures for three rolling-bearing families. Do not yet build rolling solids.
acceptance: RoBAS file/path/formula/units audit with ambiguity flags and no copied source
Typed assembly and part identities and immutable DRAFT provenance
Existing sliding bearing tests pass unchanged
Rolling test fixtures reviewed for physical validity

tasks.title: Deep-groove races and balls
tasks.objective: Implement true OCCT B-Rep deep-groove ball bearing outer race inner race toroidal raceways and independent spherical rolling elements using verified RoBAS formulas.
acceptance: Independent valid closed inner/outer race solids and Z balls
Pitch circle, ball count, envelope and raceway location tested
STEP reimport preserves Z+2 solids
Both RoBAS-reference and valid engineering test fixtures pass

tasks.title: Deep-groove complete cage and assembly
tasks.objective: Implement initial robust machined sphere-pocket cage and complete deep-groove assembly from real RoBAS geometric construction principles.
acceptance: Z pocket cavities correctly placed, no duplicate first pocket
Z balls and two rings plus cage independently addressable
Interference check separates intended contact from invalid overlaps
Assembly STEP and part-level STL roundtrip

tasks.title: Shared CAD export and HTTP routing
tasks.objective: Introduce rolling-bearing service endpoints and generalized part manifests preserving existing journal bearing API; adapt generic export, cache, geometry hash and file whitelisting.
acceptance: Sliding and rolling requests use type-specific schema validation
Full manifest files and every STL/STEP download match geometry hash
Legacy /api/cad02 paths and tests remain working
No path traversal, stale design approval injection or skipped CAD errors

tasks.title: Rolling bearing Web viewer
tasks.objective: Add precise rolling-bearing type selection and dynamic part tree/part visibility in Three.js while retaining sliding bearing sections and drawing workflow.
acceptance: Deep-groove parameters submitted through same-origin backend
Dynamic part list shows inner/outer races, balls and cage
No stale geometry shown after parameter change or failed loading
Browser tests cover both bearing families

tasks.title: Angular contact ball bearing
tasks.objective: Reimplement RoBAS single-row angular-contact ball bearing asymmetrical grooves, contact angle, balls and appropriate cage as valid B-Rep solids.
acceptance: Contact-angle configuration and axial race offsets checked
STEP roundtrip and per-part volumes valid
Misfit contact/raceway conditions rejected and documented
Three representative valid fixtures pass

tasks.title: Cylindrical roller bearing families
tasks.objective: Reimplement RoBAS cylindrical roller bearing raceways, rollers and N/NU/NJ/NUP/NF flange forms, preserving named part identities.
acceptance: All five forms generate closed solids
Roller pitch circle, count, flange configuration tested
Valid assembly STEP with part list per form
Regression suite stays green

tasks.title: Complex rolling cages and performance
tasks.objective: Port RoBAS supported stamped and roller cage alternatives where source geometry is verified and improve large-assembly mesh and generation performance.
acceptance: Cage variants checked for pocket count and placement
Large assembly remains responsive under explicit reference fixture
Failure cases are explicit, not silently approximated
B-Rep and display meshes share the same source

tasks.objective: Audit feature parity across three rolling-bearing families, resolve supported fixture defects, document unsupported RoBAS features and produce repeatable final test report.
acceptance: Deep-groove, angular contact and cylindrical roller representative STEP models reimport
